## New or changed sample

- Folder: `samples/...`

## Checklist

- [ ] The flow ran on my PC; `tested:` in `sample.yml` gives the PAD version and the date
- [ ] `version:` in `sample.yml` is new or raised, with its section in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] `python tools/build_docs.py` was run and `README.md` reads well for a beginner
- [ ] Every input and output variable has `holds` and `e.g` in `sample.yml`
- [ ] `assets/result.png` shows the result; no personal or company data in any file or picture
- [ ] English names, comments and texts; settings in the first (cyan) region
